text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of a U-turn prohibition on Burrows Hall Boulevard between Dailing Gate and Purvis Crescent (west intersection). Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Burrows Hall Boulevard which is located adjacent to Burrows Hall Junior Public School.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turns at all times on Burrows Hall Boulevard, between Dailing Gate and Purvis Crescent (west intersection).
